title: Document templates
subtitle: How generated documents look. An issued invoice keeps the version it was printed with; publishing the default changes the invoices issued from then on.
superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can edit document templates.

list.invoices: {count, plural, =0 {no invoice} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
list.duplicateBody: The copy starts as a draft of the newest layout. Publish it before making it the default.
list.name: Name
list.defaultBody: Invoices issued from now on will print with its newest published version. Invoices already issued keep theirs.
list.newBody: The new template starts as a draft copy of the default layout. Publish it before making it the default.

editor.title: Edit template
editor.subtitle: Choose the blocks, the table's columns and the margins; the preview prints the sample invoice with the layout as it stands. Saving writes a draft — nothing prints with it until it is published.
editor.editingPublished: v{version} is published and frozen — saving starts draft v{next}
editor.name: Name
editor.publishBodyDefault: This is the default template: every invoice issued from now on will print with this version. It can no longer be edited — a later change becomes a new version.
editor.publishBody: The version is frozen once published — a later change becomes a new version.
editor.invalid: The layout has problems — fix them to save or preview:
editor.previewError: The preview could not be drawn.
editor.previewHint: The sample invoice — forty made-up lines, so the second page and the last-page blocks have something to show.

page.hint: The bottom margin is reserved on every page: footer, page number and last-page blocks live in it. The first page can start lower, to clear the letterhead.

notes.title: Heading
notes.hint: Printed as typed, in every language: payment terms, bank details.

footer.hint: Leave empty for the contact line with the tax ID, translated.

designer.title: Template designer
designer.subtitle: The sheet at scale. Drag a block to move it, its corner to resize it; the preview prints the sample invoice with the result. Saving writes the same draft as the settings form.
designer.nothingSelected: Select a block on the sheet to see its position and size.
designer.blockLabel: {name}, {x} mm from the start edge, {w} mm wide

legend.flow: Flow: sideways and width only; drag past a neighbour to reorder
legend.keys: Arrows nudge 1 mm, 5 mm with Shift

designer.previewHint: Redrawn when a drag ends. Flow blocks are drawn at a nominal height on the sheet — the preview shows the real one.
